newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close higher on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close higher on short covering.

text.p: CME lumber futures traded in a much narrower trading range Thursday than on Wednesday but again ended higher on mostly short-covering support, traders said.
Reports of some cash trade at lower price levels continued to give the market underlying support and futures ended up at the best price levels in one week, they said.
However, cash lumber prices were expected to be quoted lower again Friday which tempered the advance. The cash spruce market is still seeking a bottom to its seasonal price break, they added.
Lumber closed $6.30 to $2.00 higher with November up most at $351.00 and January up $4.30 at $362.00 per tbf.
